review.tagline: Workspace for running and reviewing OpenCode agent sessions across devices
review.summary: OpenChamber is a front end for the OpenCode CLI that starts coding-agent sessions, shows diffs, and carries work through review and merge. It ships as a desktop app, a Node.js CLI serving a web/PWA UI, a VS Code extension, and iOS/Android clients sharing the same projects and sessions. It adds multi-model runs, goal-driven sessions, scheduled prompts, and GitHub issue and PR context.
review.audience: Developers who run OpenCode agents and want review and remote access
strengths: Same sessions reachable from desktop, web/PWA, VS Code, iOS and Android
Multi-run sends one task to up to five models, each optionally in its own worktree
Remote access via E2E-encrypted Private Relay, LAN/VPN, Cloudflare/Ngrok tunnels or SSH
Desktop build bundles the OpenCode CLI, so no separate install is needed
weaknesses: CLI/Web and VS Code require a separately installed OpenCode CLI
Agent runtime is tied to OpenCode; no other agent backends are listed
Feature changes must go through an Ideas discussion before a PR
